_note: SERVER-ONLY hidden negotiation config (imported only by the API route and tests, never by client code). Landlords, concessions and personalities are fictional. Floors and steps come from difficulty rules in src/game/negotiate.ts; code decides every deal.

s1-a.persona: A laid-back grad student who holds the house lease, loves the house's Sunday dinners, and just wants a housemate who's easy to live with.

concessions.label: A desk and chair left in the room

s1-b.persona: A warm, chatty owner who rents rooms in her apartment, likes having students around, and keeps the place quiet and tidy.

s1-c.persona: A friendly homeowner renting out their newly finished basement for the first time; a little nervous, eager to be fair, proud of the reno.

s2-a.persona: Sam from the rental office of a big older building; busy but genuinely kind, knows the building inside out, and wants tenants to be happy there.

s2-b.persona: An easygoing owner of a few units in a newer mid-rise who loves long-term tenants and would much rather have a nice person than an empty unit.

concessions.label: In-suite laundry at no extra charge

s2-c.persona: A friendly condo owner who's renting out the unit they used to live in, cares about who moves in, and would like it rented soon.

s2-d.persona: Elena handles a few older houses for an owner who lives out of town; she's patient, likes clear questions, and would rather fill the basement than leave it empty.

s2-e.persona: Chris owns the shop downstairs and the apartment above it, answers texts quickly, and wants a tenant who will stay more than a year.

concessions.label: Laundry card topped up for the first month

s2-f.persona: Amina lives on the first floor of the walk-up, shows the unit herself, and is careful but kind with first-time renters.
